subject: cleanx.uk mobile call button
body:
Hi there,

Came across your commercial pressure washing work in London. Solid reputation with your 11 reviews on Google.

Pulled up your site on my iPhone this morning and noticed the phone number isn't 1-tap clickable, and when you scroll down to check your past projects, the contact option disappears off the screen. Most homeowners shopping on mobile want to call with one tap; when they have to memorize or copy-paste digits, a lot of them just tap back to the next contractor on Google Maps.

I mocked up a fast, brand-matched tap-to-call bar and sticky quote button for CleanX on mobile. Would you be opposed to me sending over a short 20-second screen demo? (No pitch or pressure either way).

Best,
Faiz Majeed
FZCORE Studio
